description: Header file defining the icStringBuffer structure and related functions for string buffer manipulation in C.

methods.name: stringBufferCreate
methods.description: Creates a new icStringBuffer with specified initial size.

methods.name: stringBufferDestroy
methods.description: Destroys and frees memory of an icStringBuffer.

methods.name: stringBufferDestroy__auto
methods.description: Helper function for automatic cleanup of icStringBuffer.

methods.name: stringBufferAppend
methods.description: Appends a string to the buffer, copying its contents.

methods.name: stringBufferAppendLength
methods.description: Appends a specified length of a string to the buffer.

methods.name: stringBufferAppendWithComma
methods.description: Appends a string with a comma, either at the beginning or end.

methods.name: stringBufferLength
methods.description: Returns the current length of the buffer contents.

methods.name: stringBufferToString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the buffer as a null-terminated string.
